top_cwe_coverage_note: 14-way equal-count dataset: 10 classes cover 10/14≈0.714, below 0.80; using top-10 anyway, remainder in other
sampling: from parse_ok ∩ not reserved ∩ teacher first-line verdict parseable; parse failures never enter the 200

cause_provisional.no_func_sig_head: snippet does not start with a recognizable function signature
cause_provisional.truncated_tail: body does not end with } or ;
cause_provisional.kernel_macros: e.g. kvm_for_each_memslot — parser sees a call-like identifier, often still parse_ok; remaining fails mix macros + chopped BigVul text

gate_decision.representativeness: Phase 0 battery is sampled from the parseable 82.6% only. Conclusions do not cover the unparseable 17.4%. If those functions are systematically harder (macro-heavy, truncated), the training/eval distribution is biased. Estimate in Phase 1.
gate_decision.decision: logged as a gate record; not a silent footnote
